strings.legal.terms.sections[3].title: Kod iwdi e sosde e sarwisaaji maa
strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: Kod iwdi pdff yaltinaama les sariya MIT. Aɗa waawi janngude ɗum, ƴeewtindude ɗum, waɗde ɗum e sarwisaaji maa (hay e moƴƴo mo internet alaa), waylude ɗum e yaltinde ɗum yoɓtaake, so aɗa reeni maantol hakke keɓal e tinndinol sariya.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Kuutoragol jaɓataango

strings.legal.security.title: Kisnal e kabaruuji
strings.legal.security.description: Ko wonata e fiilde maa dow pdff: golle baɗeteeɗe e hoore maɓɓe, alaa ƴeewndo, momtagol jawmirdi, sutndol, hoɗgol e Europe, e cuɓagol waɗde ɗum e serveruuji maa.
strings.legal.security.intro: Ko wonata e fiilde maa, to ɗe gollirtee e no ɗe reyniraa: firtiraama no feewi, wonande yimɓe fof e sarwiisiiji IT kadi.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Alaa fiilde dananaande
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Fiilde maa ina peeŋee, rewi heen ina momtee so eɓɓaande yaltii walla yoogama. Alaa kosi, alaa baakup e alaa taariika. Momtugo gollirngal ñalnde kala ina momta kadi fiilde fotnde duumeede, ñalnde aroore.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Alaa yuɓɓingol
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Alaa janngata fiilde maa. Ɗe ndarntaake, yuɓɓintaake, semtintaake walla huutortee ngam jannginde miijo ganndo. pdff alaa kontoo, alaa paaspooruuji e alaa teeltugol kuutorooɓe.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Naatnugol e sirlu
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Kala jokkondiral ko sirlinaangol (HTTPS) e lowre ndee ina yaara e sirlu kala yillude (HSTS). Kaɓirgal Reenu ina sirlina PDF maa e AES-256; finnde suɓaaɗe ndee danataake.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: To fiilde maa peeŋata
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Lowre, kaɓirɗe PDF e nate: Vercel, to Paris data center (Farayse, Dental Ewrop). Waylooji Word, Excel e PowerPoint: Render, to Frankfurt (Almaañ, Dental Ewrop). Fiilde ɓurnde 4 MB: Vercel Blob temporer, e innde wawde, momtinaande caggal kuutoragol.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Reenugol teknik
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Maantol kisnal (HSTS, haɗde lowre nde naatneede e hello goɗɗe, reenu e jillondiral sifaa fiilde), aderesi fiilde temporer mo anndaaka, e sarwisa waylo jaɓoowo tan naamnal jowitiingol e maantol sirlu. Kala waylo kod ina ƴeewtee (tappirde, ƴeewte sifaa) adii yaltude.

strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: pdff yaltinaama to New Brunswick e ina jowitii e sariya Kanadaa jowitiiɗi e Reenugol Kabaruuji Neɗɗo e Fiilde Elektronik (PIPEDA). Ina moofta kabaruuji keertiiɗi e kuutorooɓe mum: alaa kontoo, alaa aderesi mail, alaa kukoo fendoo. Ina mahi e laabi goongɗi gila e GDPR Ewrop e Sariya 25 Quebec: famɗingol kabaruuji, alaa kadi huutoraade, momtugol caggal peeŋngol.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Wonande pelle keeriɗe e sariyaaji tiiɗɗi

strings.legal.accessibility.title: Heɓgol
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Tinndinol heɓgol pdff: faandaare WCAG 2.2 tolno AA, peewal wonngal, keeri anndaaɗi e no miññirde bonannde.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Kala neɗɗo ina foti waawde huutoraade pdff, hay wumɓe walla ɓe gite mum en njaamaani, mantiɓe walla ɓe njettaaki, walla jom en ñawu njuɓɓudi walla miijo.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Faandaare fannu
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: pdff ina faandi jowitugo e Laabi Heɓgol Binndol Lowre (WCAG) 2.2, tolno AA, fannu winndereyankeewo W3C. Tolno o ina huutoroo naamne Laabi Laamu Kanadaa jowitiiɗi e Heɓgol Lowre, fannu Ewrop EN 301 549 e Tappirde 508 to Dowlaaji Dentuɗi, ɗe njiylotoo WCAG 2.0 walla 2.1 tolno AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Tollirgol fannu
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: pdff ina jowitii e WCAG 2.2 tolno AA: keeri anndaaɗi ina limtee les ɗoo. Ndee tinndinol jowitii e ƴeewtindugol e nder ñalnde 2 Oktoobere 2026, huutoraade kaɓirɗe peewaaɗe (axe, Lighthouse) e ƴeewte lollorɗe (koɗol, ceertugol, mawngol, hollirgol). Alaa ƴeewtindugol keeriiɗo waɗaama haa jooni.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Ko woni e nokku
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Lowre ndee fof ina gollira e koɗol, e jokkondiral “Diw to koɗol” e mbedda yiytekaaɗe e geɗe gollorɗe. Ceertugol binndol ko 4:1 walla ɓuri. Ɗowgol golle (neldu, yaltngol, bonannde) ina hollitiree janngooɓe yiyngo. Limoore fiilde ina waawi wayleede tawa dente alaa, huutoraade butonuuji. Lowre ndee ina jokki teeltugol kaɓirgal “famɗingol lollugol”: mbeddaaji ina ndarta. Hello ina waawi janngineede e 400% mawngol e e telefon. Ɗemngal kala hello ina hollitee, kadi Arab ina hollitee gila ñaamo haa nano.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Keeri anndaaɗi
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Tawa teeltugol ngol alaa, mbeddaaji njuuteendi (badru, duuɗal, ticker fannu) ina ndiyamte; ticker ina waɗta tonngere e hoore e koɗol. Duuɗal mbedda dow hello fuɗɗoore ina gollira e lollorɗe walla koli; ko geɗel, kadi doggol fannuuji ngol hollitii ina heɓii kadi e binndol dow hello.
